comment: * Tracks the global strong authentication state.

variables.name: STRONG_AUTH_REQUIRED_AFTER_BOOT
variables.comment: * Strong authentication is required because the user has not authenticated since boot.

variables.name: STRONG_AUTH_REQUIRED_AFTER_DPM_LOCK_NOW
variables.comment: * Strong authentication is required because a device admin has requested it.

variables.name: SOME_AUTH_REQUIRED_AFTER_USER_REQUEST
variables.comment: * Some authentication is required because the user has temporarily disabled trust.

variables.name: STRONG_AUTH_REQUIRED_AFTER_LOCKOUT
variables.comment:
* Strong authentication is required because the user has been locked out after too many
         * attempts using primary auth methods (i.e. PIN/pattern/password) from the lock screen,
         * Android Settings, and BiometricPrompt where user authentication is required.

variables.name: STRONG_AUTH_REQUIRED_AFTER_TIMEOUT
variables.comment:
* Strong authentication is required because it hasn't been used for a time required by
         * a device admin.

variables.name: STRONG_AUTH_REQUIRED_AFTER_USER_LOCKDOWN
variables.comment: * Strong authentication is required because the user has triggered lockdown.

variables.name: STRONG_AUTH_REQUIRED_FOR_UNATTENDED_UPDATE
variables.comment: * Strong authentication is required to prepare for unattended upgrade.

variables.name: STRONG_AUTH_REQUIRED_AFTER_NON_STRONG_BIOMETRICS_TIMEOUT
variables.comment:
* Strong authentication is required because it hasn't been used for a time after a
         * non-strong biometric (i.e. weak or convenience biometric) is used to unlock device.

variables.name: SOME_AUTH_REQUIRED_AFTER_TRUSTAGENT_EXPIRED
variables.comment:
* Some authentication is required because the trustagent either timed out or was disabled
         * manually.

variables.name: SOME_AUTH_REQUIRED_AFTER_ADAPTIVE_AUTH_REQUEST
variables.comment:
* Some authentication is required because adaptive auth has requested to lock device due to
         * repeated failed primary auth (i.e. PIN/pattern/password) or biometric auth attempts which
         * can come from Android Settings or BiometricPrompt where user authentication is required,
         * in addition to from the lock screen. When a risk is determined, adaptive auth will
         * proactively prompt the lock screen and will require users to re-enter the device with
         * either primary auth or biometric auth (if not prohibited by other flags).

variables.name: ALLOWING_BIOMETRIC
variables.comment:
* Strong auth flags that do not prevent biometric methods from being accepted as auth.
         * If any other flags are set, biometric authentication is disabled.

methods.name: public int getStrongAuthForUser(int userId)
methods.comment:
* Returns {@link #STRONG_AUTH_NOT_REQUIRED} if strong authentication is not required,
         * otherwise returns a combination of {@link StrongAuthFlags} indicating why strong
         * authentication is required.
         *
         * @param userId the user for whom the state is queried.

methods.name: public boolean isTrustAllowedForUser(int userId)
methods.comment:
* @return true if unlocking with trust alone is allowed for {@code userId} by the current
         * strong authentication requirements.

methods.name: public boolean isBiometricAllowedForUser(boolean isStrongBiometric, int userId)
methods.comment:
* @return true if unlocking with a biometric method alone is allowed for {@code userId}
         * by the current strong authentication requirements.

methods.name: public boolean isNonStrongBiometricAllowedAfterIdleTimeout(int userId)
methods.comment:
* @return true if unlocking with a non-strong (i.e. weak or convenience) biometric method
         * alone is allowed for {@code userId}, otherwise returns false.

methods.name: public void onStrongAuthRequiredChanged(int userId)
methods.comment: * Called when the strong authentication requirements for {@code userId} changed.

methods.name: public void onIsNonStrongBiometricAllowedChanged(int userId)
methods.comment: * Called when whether non-strong biometric is allowed for {@code userId} changed.

methods.name: protected void handleStrongAuthRequiredChanged(@StrongAuthFlags int strongAuthFlags, int userId)

protected void handleStrongAuthRequiredChanged(@StrongAuthFlags int strongAuthFlags, int userId)
